# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My pick for most people: JBL Charge 6.** It's the top choice at What Hi-Fi and BestProducts, and iTechGuides also calls it the best overall. It's IP68-rated and doubles as a power bank. Prices in the reviews range from $129.99 at Walmart to $149.95 at Amazon. Battery life is reported differently: 28 hours at BestProducts, 20 hours at What Hi-Fi and iTechGuides.
- [What Hi-Fi (Walmart and Amazon links)](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- [BestProducts (Amazon, Walmart, Lowe's)](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

## Other good options

| Need | Speaker | Why | Where to buy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small and easy to pack | JBL Grip (~$100) | Soda-can shape, IP68, under a pound, 12-hour battery. Good Housekeeping's DJ tester made it best overall. The mesh can trap sand and dust. | [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/) (Amazon, Walmart, Macy's) |
| Cheapest | JBL Go 5 ($39.95) | What Hi-Fi's best budget pick | [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) |
| Budget that floats | Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 (~$65) | 360° sound, floats, good battery but not great | [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) |
| Best for pool parties | Soundcore Boom 2 Plus | 100 W, IPX7, floats, up to 20 hours (with lights off), can charge your phone. It weighs 3.8 kg. | [Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) |
| Loudest and biggest | JBL Boombox 4 | RTINGS' top waterproof pick | [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart) |
| Best overall at Tom's Guide | Ultimate Ears Epicboom (IP67) | Balanced sound, but not cheap | [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) (Amazon, Newegg) |

**Soundcore Boom 2 Plus deal:** The list price is $249.99. Dealectric says it tested code AFSC20 in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22 and got $49.99 off, which brings it to about $200. The code expires 2026-12-31, and checkout has the final word. The link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. There's also a conflict on Bluetooth version: Soundcore's product page says 6.0, while its manual says 5.3.

## Care tips
- **Saltwater and chlorine:** RTINGS notes that IP ratings only measure water getting in, not corrosion from salt or chlorine. Rinse the speaker with fresh water after use, especially fabric-covered models.
- **Charging:** Keep the charging port covered, and let the speaker dry fully before you charge it.
- **IP67 vs. IP68:** Both handle temporary immersion, but neither makes a speaker an underwater device.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocketable or party-loud, I can narrow it to one.
